newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone added 146,000 UK subscribers in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone added 146,000 UK subscribers in Q4.

text.p: Vodafone Group Plc, the British mobile telephone operator, said on Thursday it had connected up more than 320,000 subscribers in the last calendar quarter of 1996 which produced over 1,460,000 net new subscribers.
In a statement the company said the figures showed "continued strong subcriber growth" both in the UK and abroad.
"For the first time in 1996 the quarter was better at both a gross and net level than the equivalent quarter of 1995," when the gross increase was 286,000 and the net 143,000, Vodafone added.
